key.name: mode
key.description: automatic: follow hardware tablet switch when present; always-desktop / always-tablet: force the mode.

key.name: enable-experimental-gestures
key.summary: Enable experimental tablet edge gesture capture
key.description: Off by default: the gesture actor can conflict with GNOME's on-screen keyboard and is not yet verified on physical touch hardware.

key.name: open-home-on-tablet
key.summary: Open app grid on tablet transition
key.description: When entering tablet mode, show the Show Applications grid as Home.

key.name: touch-text-scale
key.summary: Temporary text scale factor while in tablet mode
key.description: Applied only while tablet mode is active and only if the user has not set a custom text scaling. Restored on exit. Respects accessibility overrides.

key.name: collapse-dock-in-tablet
key.summary: Collapse or hide the dock in tablet mode
key.description: Attempts to collapse the dock (Dash to Dock or similar) while in tablet mode and restore the previous state on exit.

key.name: rotation-lock
key.summary: Lock screen rotation while in tablet mode
key.description: When true, disables auto-rotation for the duration of tablet mode.

key.name: gesture-exceptions
key.summary: Window classes that suppress edge gestures
key.description: List of WM_CLASS or app IDs (e.g. steam, org.gnome.Calculator) for which bottom-edge gestures are temporarily disabled. Useful for fullscreen games.
